failure_modes: Mechanism promises checks over artefacts a service of this shape would ordinarily emit, but frame-002 records that no artefact exists in the fixture. Face-value execution risks asserting log names and metrics as existing, breaching the acceptance criterion against unflagged assumptions.

Taking prem-005's closed world at face value satisfies the brief's letter but leaves the fourth-cause risk unaddressed beyond a named caveat; discrimination among three explanations is vacuous if the true cause is outside the set.

No ordering among the three checks is given, so the brief cannot state which is cheapest or which subsumes another. Acceptance permits this, but it is a weakness in the deliverable rather than a defect in the candidate.
Falsification test is stated as a reviewer judgement with only the problem statement, which is the same evidence the author had; it is weakly independent.
